data.body: Verification: ticket compact-all fix (7105ca63) may have reduced per-ticket cost, but single ticket show still takes ~6.6s. With only 1 open epic currently, cannot reproduce the 144+ epic scenario. The architectural issue persists: N sequential subprocess calls in the candidate-load loop. The optimization (parsing data from initial ticket list output instead of per-ticket ticket show) is still valid but cannot be verified against the original scenario. Deferring — the fix is relevant when epic count grows back above ~11.
